summary: A switch: a native checkbox exposed as role="switch", with label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the box and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the box.

errorMessage.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while checked.

selected.note: On/off state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be checked. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

size.note: Track and thumb size. medium 32x20, small 24x16.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The track; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation. Drawn as the track.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: The sliding knob; not focusable, aria-hidden.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

selected.note: Track in primary; thumb moves to the end.

error.trigger: error-message set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals: setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default state, disabled is not submitted.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (24x16 small); the label beside it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009)

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; its checked state is the on state (no aria-checked: ARIA in HTML forbids it on a checkbox)
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and applies as soon as it changes
The choice is part of a form that is submitted later
useCases.use: sb-switch or Checkbox; give it a name

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch whose state is unclear from its label
antiPatterns.why: On/off must be obvious without reading the thumb position
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that states the setting, e.g. "Airplane mode"

antiPatterns.pattern: Several independent options in a list needing a Save

coverage: role switch named by label; label click toggles; native checkbox, no aria-checked
Space toggles; thumb moves; keyboard focus ring
medium 32x20 / 16px thumb and small 24x16 / 12px thumb; on uses primary track
description and error in the accessible description; aria-invalid
required: native required, aria-hidden asterisk, invalid after blur
input and change composed, once per toggle
form value only while on, custom value, reset to attribute default, validity, disabled fieldset, errorMessage customError, label for

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn uses input (neutral-200); changed for WCAG 1.4.11
shadcn uses 32x18.4 (sm 24x14); the foundation scale has no such steps
shadcn uses foreground for the unchecked thumb in dark mode

coverage: Switch: 24 variant(s), Size (Medium, Small) x State (Rest, Focus) x Selected (False, True) x Validation (None, Error) x Disabled (False, True); read back ok

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern, label row beside the track.

openQuestions.question: How is the on state exposed?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox with role="switch": its checked state is the switch state; no aria-checked.

openQuestions.question: Track and thumb sizes against the foundation scale?
openQuestions.answer: The visual reference uses 18.4 and 14 px track heights. The foundation scale has no such steps, so semantic size.switch.* tokens use 20x32 and 16x24 and the thumbs 16 and 12. Logged as drift.
